The apparent 'kink' near zero is a small smooth nonlinearity (a slight S-curve/dip) rather than two distinct lines [E12, E10, E5]

The exact functional form of the near-zero smooth transition is not yet pinned down; a small tanh-like correction around x=0 fits best so far [E12]?
